blocking: Mobile navigation has no height limit or internal scrolling; lower links can become unreachable in short landscape viewports or with enlarged text.
ScrollTrigger limitCallbacks can leave reveal content invisible after scrolling past an entire trigger range; the recovery currently runs only for scripted anchor navigation.

fixes.what: Cap the drawer at calc(100dvh - var(--header-h)), enable overflow-y:auto, and add data-lenis-prevent to the navigation.
fixes.why: Every navigation item must remain reachable on short screens and with enlarged text.

fixes.what: Remove limitCallbacks:true for reveal behavior, or explicitly complete unrevealed targets whose trigger range has been passed during ordinary scrolling.
fixes.why: Fast scrolling and scrollbar jumps must not strand content at opacity:0.

fixes.what: Synchronize hidden controls' keyboard availability immediately with their visual state; preserve visibility for a focused control and restore availability immediately when showing it.
fixes.why: The 700ms delay currently permits invisible tab stops and temporarily visible controls excluded from keyboard navigation.

fixes.what: Use an opaque gold or another verified high-contrast underline for unfocused fields instead of rgba(201,158,92,.45).
fixes.why: The translucent underline and nearly identical input background make field boundaries difficult to distinguish.

fixes.what: Track this site's animations in a GSAP context and revert that context instead of clearing gsap.globalTimeline and killing every ScrollTrigger.
fixes.why: Global teardown would also destroy animations belonging to any subsequently added component.
